text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, are you working out again? 
Ryan-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my body fat percentage went up a 
bit, you see. So I'm cutting down a little 
more intensely than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, would I be in the wayif I worked 
out in the room?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No, don't worry about that at all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If it's Ryan-chan, though, I feel like 
bending the rules a little might be okay.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
See? Ryan-chan is always working out, so 
she's super lean, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"No, gaining weight even though you train 
all the time is proof you're still not 
doing enough muscle training!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta make sure I stay in tip-top 
shape so I can run at full strength 
whenever I need to!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Ryan-chan is just so cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After some rigorous training, Mejiro Ryan 
seemed to have successfully lost weight.
